source_units.text: I have compared you, my companion, to my mare among Pharaoh’s chariots.
source_units.display_text: I have compared you, my companion, to my mare among Pharaoh’s chariots.

source_units.text: The beams of our houses are cedars; our ceiling panels are cypresses.
source_units.display_text: The beams of our houses are cedars; our ceiling panels are cypresses.

source_units.text: Catch for us the little foxes that destroy vineyards, for our vines are flowering.
source_units.display_text: Catch for us the little foxes that destroy vineyards, for our vines are flowering.

source_units.text: He made its pillars silver and its reclining support gold; its step was purple, its interior paved with stone—love from the daughters of Jerusalem.
source_units.display_text: He made its pillars silver and its reclining support gold; its step was purple, its interior paved with stone—love from the daughters of Jerusalem.

source_units.text: I took off my tunic; how could I put it on? I washed my feet; how could I soil them?
source_units.display_text: I took off my tunic; how could I put it on? I washed my feet; how could I soil them?

source_units.text: My kinsman extended his hand from the opening, and my belly was stirred for him.
source_units.display_text: My kinsman extended his hand from the opening, and my belly was stirred for him.

source_units.text: My soul did not know; it set me among Amminadab’s chariots.
source_units.display_text: My soul did not know; it set me among Amminadab’s chariots.

source_units.text: Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, and we will look at you. What will you see in the Shulammite? She comes like dances of the camps.
source_units.display_text: Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, and we will look at you. What will you see in the Shulammite? She comes like dances of the camps.

source_units.text: How beautiful and how delightful you have become, love, in your delights!
source_units.display_text: How beautiful and how delightful you have become, love, in your delights!
